opportunities.name: Ryanair round-trip flight search
opportunities.description: Search a round-trip flight on Ryanair for a given origin, destination, dates and passenger count, then select outbound and return fares.
steps: Click From and choose origin country then airport
Click To and choose destination country then airport
Pick depart date in calendar
Pick return date in calendar
Open passengers and set adult count, click Done
Click Search
Select outbound flight and return flight Select buttons
Optionally apply promo code and re-search

instances.values: Dublin to Athens, Apr 2 to Apr 5, 1 adult (partial, with idle gaps)
Dublin to Malta, Sat 22 Apr, 2 adults

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search by destination and date
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com Attractions for a place and date, then open a result and choose tickets.
steps: Open Attractions tab
Enter destination in Where are you going or pick a destination tile
Click Select your dates and pick a date
Click Search
Apply filters or sort (free cancellation, city, category, most popular)
Open a result and click See availability
Choose date, set ticket counts, click Next

instances.values: Kyoto, 25 May, free cancellation, tours, most popular, 2 adults + 1 infant

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and notify
opportunities.description: Search a restaurant on Resy, open its page, and set a Notify for a meal time, optionally changing date, guests and city.
steps: Type restaurant or cuisine in search box
Click the matching restaurant
Set guests and date if needed
Click Notify for the meal
Set preferred time range
Click Confirm
